name: Form
description:
The <form> element for a `useAppForm` instance. Submitting (button or Enter) validates
every field, focuses the first invalid one, or saves: the SubmitButton shows pending →
✓ in place, and the form takes the saved values as its new baseline. Pass the saved
record back as `defaultValues` (it normally comes from the server).
signature: ({ form, onError, className, children, ...rest }: FormProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: form
props.description: Form instance whose values, validation and submission state are observed.

props.name: onError
props.description: A failed save (onSubmit threw). The button shows ✕; put the reason in a toast here.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
